 │ Do you trust the files in this folder?                                                                                                                                                             │
 │                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
 │ Trusting a folder allows Gemini CLI to load its local configurations, including custom commands, hooks, MCP servers, agent skills, and settings. These configurations could execute code on your   │
 │ behalf or change the behavior of the CLI.                                                                                                                                                          │
 │                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

 │ ● 1. Trust folder (work)                                                                                                                                                                           │
 │   2. Trust parent folder (tmp)                                                                                                                                                                     │
 │   3. Don't trust                                                                                                                                                                                   │
